title: Top Personalized Products for Winter Sales
summary: A complete list to offer personalized winter items in your online store. Discover which products sell best and customizable ideas to propose
body_markdown:
When considering the right winter items, it's important to think about what winter represents: cold, stillness, renewal, coziness, and reflection. As winter is a season for family union, holiday celebrations, and staying warm, many great seasonal items can be offered during this period of the year to increase sales. It's not a small window either: US holiday retail sales crossed $1 trillion for the first time in 2025, according to the National Retail Federation.


Discover which are the customizable seasonal products that you can offer in your online store ❄️☃️


## **What sells best during winter?**


During the winter season, specific categories of products see significant sales increases due to factors like cold weather and holiday shopping.


- **Warm apparel** is in first position since Winter clothing sales typically increase by 30-50% during November and December. In 2021, the global winter wear market was valued at $268 billion, with significant demand for coats, sweaters, and accessories. Additionally, items like hoodies, T-shirts, and socks have become popular because they are ideal for customization, allowing customers to create cozy, unique looks.
- Millions of dollars are spent annually on **holiday decorations** , with Christmas trees, lights, and ornaments being top sellers. 86% of customers decorate for the holidays, driving a seasonal surge in home décor sales.
- In addition to decorations, **holiday gifts** rank third in terms of annual sales. Many consumers prefer buying gift sets, especially personalized and bundled options.
- Sales of **boots and winter shoes** increase by 20-25% during the cold months. Within this category, we can find slippers, usually chosen as presents and perfect to customize.
- **Hot beverage** sales, especially coffee, and hot chocolate, see a 10-15% increase during winter. These sales are accompanied by matching products like cups and tumblers which have become a tendency on social media in the last few years.
- **Books and board games** are key to spending a comfortable winter at home and that’s why they rank among the favorite items for winter purchases.


## **10 categories with the best customizable items to sell in winter**


**1. Apparel:**


[Hoodies, T-shirts, and socks](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/t-shirts) are a top choice for customization. It is always a good idea to offer options like personalized text, monograms, or holiday-themed graphics. Custom scarves and Christmas stockings, embroidered with names or initials, are also great for gifting. Personalized beanies, gloves, and even winter jackets could be added to the mix for premium options.


**2. Holiday ornaments:**


They remain one of customers' favorite Christmas items. Customizing[ornaments](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/ornaments) with family names, special dates, and photos makes them even more special and attracts buyers. Ornaments shaped like snowflakes, reindeer, or mini stockings are customer favorites.


**3. Home Décor:**


Since people love feeling that Christmas is in the air and everywhere,[home decor](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/home-decor) is key to feeling the Christmas spirit in every corner of the house. Home décor items like customizable coasters with family names or holiday quotes are perfect for winter parties. Offer decorative pillows with winter landscapes or festive sayings. Customizable throw blankets, festive doormats, or wall plaques featuring winter or holiday motifs would enhance this category.


**4. Mugs and drinkware:**


[Mugs](https://www.customily.com/sell-personalized-products/mugs-drinkware) , especially customized ones, are among the best-selling items during the colder months. Mugs with holiday-themed designs, family photos, or funny winter quotes are a huge hit. Expand this category to include customizable thermoses, insulated water bottles, and wine glasses with festive etchings.


**5. Games:**


Families love spending time indoors during winter. Personalized puzzles with a family photo or custom playing cards with holiday themes are great gift ideas. Create customizable board games or jigsaw puzzles with winter landscapes or family portraits for an extra unique touch.


**6. Gifts and toys:**


Customizable teddy bears with embroidered names or a personalized apron for the home chef make great gifts. You could even add holiday-themed aprons for seasonal cooking. Other alternatives to consider are customizable plush toys, personalized toy storage bins for kids, or even holiday-themed dolls with unique outfits and names.


**7. Calendars:**


Personalized wall or desk calendars are popular items, especially when customized with personal photos, quotes, or important dates like birthdays and anniversaries. Expand to planners or journals with customizable covers for those who like to plan or record their daily activities.


**8. Gift cards:**


Gift cards are still very popular among holiday gifts and they can be made more personal by offering custom packaging or messages that reflect the recipient's personality. Customizable gift wrapping paper, gift bags, and gift tags with the recipient’s name or a holiday greeting can create a unique gifting experience.


**9. Bags:**


Who doesn’t like receiving a customized tote bag, backpack, or travel bag as a present? With sustainability in mind, it is a perfect option to offer customizable tote bags with names, holiday artwork, or family pictures. Winter-specific travel bags for holiday trips or personalized reusable shopping bags for the eco-conscious customer.


**10. Stationery and office supplies:**


Personalized[notebooks, pens, and notepads](https://customily.myshopify.com/collections/stationery-books/products/personalized-hardcover-journal-customized-street-map) are great for students, professionals, or as gifts. Holiday-themed stationery sets with custom designs, personalized holiday cards, or even customized planners for the new year are excellent additions to the winter season.


**11. Candles and home fragrance:**


Winter is when shoppers lean into coziness at home, and a personalized candle with a name, a scent note, or a short message on the label makes a simple, low-cost gift feel intentional. Offer custom labels for a few core scents rather than a huge catalog, since the personalization is what sells it, not the fragrance variety.


**12. Pet winter accessories:**


Cold weather means pets need gear too. Custom knit sweaters with a pet's name, engraved winter collar tags, or a personalized pet blanket are quick, high-margin add-ons that pet owners are happy to buy alongside their own holiday shopping.
